points.description: Explains the similarity: pandas and koalas are both specialists, with diets limited almost entirely to one food (pandas eat almost nothing but bamboo; koalas eat eucalyptus leaves almost exclusively). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the answer gives the bamboo and eucalyptus details without saying they are specialists or have limited diets, or if it is only partly explained.

levels.says: Says both are specialists, or both have very restricted diets, but gives no supporting detail from the article (no bamboo/eucalyptus).

points.description: Explains the difference: pythons are generalists that can adapt and thrive in many environments or foods (e.g. live in and spread across new places such as the Everglades, eat alligators, climates in a third of the U.S.), unlike the specialists, which depend on stable, specific conditions. Uses article support. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the answer states the contrast only vaguely or gives article evidence without naming the generalist/specialist distinction.

levels.says: Says pythons are generalists or adaptable, but gives no article evidence or no contrast with pandas and koalas.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the shared specialist trait of pandas and koalas (with article detail) and the contrast with pythons as adaptable generalists (with article detail). Partial marks go for correct but vague or unsupported statements. No marks for answers unrelated to diet or adaptability.
